name: GitLab
symbol: Bitbucket Cloud Issues and Wikis API endpoints
title: GitLab: Bitbucket Cloud Issues and Wikis API endpoints removed
summary: Atlassian is sunsetting Bitbucket Cloud Issues and Wikis on August 20, 2026. After that date, the underlying API endpoints are removed and GitLab can no longer import issues or wikis from Bitbucket Cloud
replacement: Complete imports before August 20, 2026, use the CSV import after exporting from Bitbucket, or clone the Bitbucket wiki repository locally before the due date.
